item.title: Government extends import curbs on low-ash metallurgical coke till June 2026

review.headline_rewrite: Government extends import curbs on low-ash metallurgical coke till June 2026
bullets: The government on Wednesday said it is extending import restrictions on low-ash metallurgical coke from January 1 till June 30, 2026.
However, the coke with high-ash content (above 18 per cent) is outside the scope of this restriction.
